long_description:
Join The Girl Next Door for a few hours dedicated to your mind, body, and well-being, surrounded by a community of Latinas in NYC.

Expect a morning of movement, mindfulness, and self-care, including a yoga class, guided meditation, and facial sculpting session — plus time to connect, meet new people, and discover Latina-owned wellness brands.

**10:00 AM — Yoga Class led by Livia Prasinos**

**11:00 AM — Breathwork & Meditation by Carlota Perez with Love Yourself Experiences**

**12:00 PM — Facial Sculpting Session by Skinluxe Montclair**

**Please note:** All ticket sales are final and non-refundable. Tickets cannot be refunded after purchase. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in New York.
